# Acridine Orange (free dye, basic ethanol) - absorption
# Free-dye-in-organic-solvent spectrum only. Acridine Orange's emission (and to a
# lesser extent absorption) shifts strongly with binding state: dsDNA-bound
# ('orthochromatic', ~490-502/520-530 nm) vs RNA/ssDNA/acidic-vesicle-bound
# ('metachromatic', ~460/640-650 nm). This curve is neither of those - it is the
# free dye in basic ethanol. Do not use as a stand-in for the DNA- or RNA-bound
# channel without re-checking; only single-point ex/em maxima are published for
# the bound states (see data/fluorophores.yaml note).
# Raw units: molar extinction coefficient (M^-1 cm^-1), peak eps=49138 at 430.75 nm.
